subject: Executive ally mapping + EB slotting — MAP & close-week plan
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Alice Martin <alice@nimbohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive ally mapping + EB slotting — MAP & close-week plan

Hi Alice / team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — we left with a clear path toward a short evaluation window and a potential August close target. To keep momentum I put together a Mutual Action Plan (attached draft) and a proposed Executive Briefing (EB) cadence. Key asks:

1) Can you confirm the executive sponsor(s) you want in the EB? (Name, role, email)
2) Are there any blackout dates the week of Aug 7–13? We are aiming to host the EB in that window to sync on procurement and integration gates.
3) Any outstanding compliance artifacts you need prior to the EB (SOC, data flow diagrams, etc.)? We can include a one-pager with the security summary.

Attached: Nimbo_MAP_draft_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones and owners) and EB_availability_grid.xlsx (proposed slots). Proposed near-term milestones:
- Week of Jul 18: finalize MAP and lock exec invite list
- Week of Jul 25: run technical deep dive with integration leads
- Week of Aug 7: Exec Briefing (30–45m) + procurement checklist review

Marissa — can you take point on the EB invite and calendar ops if Alice confirms sponsor names? Ben — can you take ownership of the MAP finalization & one-pager security summary?

Alice — appreciate any initial feedback and the sponsor names when you have them.

Thanks!

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Nimbo_MAP_draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft), EB_availability_grid.xlsx (calendar slots)

From: Alice Martin <alice@nimbohealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@nimbohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive ally mapping + EB slotting — MAP & close-week plan

Thanks Hannah — this looks helpful and timely.

Sponsor: Mark Rivera, CFO (mark.rivera@nimbohealth.com) will be the primary exec for the EB. He asked that the EB focus on cost predictability and auditability (token-level cost breakdown + audit log retention).

Availability: Mark is available Aug 8 (10–11am PT) and Aug 10 (1–2pm PT). We've uploaded our internal availability to the EB_availability_grid.xlsx (attached).

Compliance asks: please include a one-page summary that lists SOC2 status, retention controls, and the KMS options — that will speed procurement. If you can also share a short list of references for finance teams that have closed in the same quarter, that helps.

I'll loop our procurement lead if we need to surface CLA/terms early.

On the MAP itself — I left two high-level comments in page 2 about integration milestones; we'll confirm with our infra lead next week.

Marissa: draft the EB invite to include Mark Rivera and one additional product executive (TBD). Use Aug 8 10–11am PT as the primary slot and Aug 10 1–2pm PT as the fallback. Include the procurement checklist and the one-pager as pre-read. Target: send invites by Jul 22.

Jordan: pull two recent finance reference case studies (anonymized) and a short note on billing/commit flexibility. Attach to the invite.

Alice / Mark — we will confirm final invite by Jul 22 once internal items are attached. Thanks for the quick turnaround on availability.
